summary: Closed the main repo-side CI/bootstrap gap for the remaining services-listing browser gates. `service-quote-e2e` now declares the current bootstrap mode explicitly in `.gitlab-ci.yml`, the fail-fast validator in `scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.mjs` is stronger and regression-tested in `tests/scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.test.mjs`, and the E2E docs now describe the active service-browser contract instead of leaving it implicit. The validator now enforces the actual preview/runtime assumptions for the current service/homepage Playwright slice: required service specs and Chromium visual baselines must exist, the route-harness/mocked-request contract must remain intact, the expected TEST-G3/TEST-G4 command slices must still be present in `.gitlab-ci.yml`, CI must provide `VITE_API_URL`, `VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL`, and `VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true`, and preview mode must have both `build/` and `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js` unless `PW_E2E_BASE_URL` overrides the server target. Verification passed for the new validator itself (`node --test tests/scripts/validate-service-e2e-bootstrap.test.mjs`), the simulated CI pass path (`CI=1 VITE_API_URL=https://api.example.test VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL=wss://relay.example.test VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true npm run test:e2e:validate-service-bootstrap`), and `git diff --check` on the touched CI/doc/validator files. The next blocker is now concrete rather than implicit: this local workspace still lacks `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js`, so a CI-shaped Playwright rerun still fails before the first browser assertion because `vite preview` cannot start until the full preview artifact contract is satisfied.
remaining_work: Ensure the upstream build artifact used by `service-quote-e2e` preserves `.svelte-kit/output/server/manifest.js` alongside `build/`, then rerun the service Playwright job in the CI-shaped environment.

Run the remaining Chromium and Mobile Safari `service-quotes-*`, `service-ux-hardening*`, `service-instant-buy*`, `homepage-featured-services*`, and `tasks-services-regression-*` suites once the preview artifact contract is satisfied.
Run the Chromium visual slice (`service-quotes-visual*`, `homepage-featured-services-visual*`) in the final CI-shaped environment after the preview bootstrap artifact issue is resolved.
Finish the remaining `TEST-G3` / `TEST-G4` evidence pass and address any browser-level failures that surface after the CI bootstrap artifact issue is resolved.

Verify the final `CI-G1` external requirements in the real GitLab environment, including merge-required job behavior and project merge-policy enforcement, once CI runtime variables and project API access are available.
